ip_top_stories.title: Another judge agrees: AI-Created art isn't copyrightable
ip_top_stories.summary: A US federal judge has reaffirmed the position that artwork generated solely by AI cannot be protected by copyright, consistent with prior rulings and US Copyright Office guidance requiring human authorship. The decision adds to a growing body of case law clarifying the boundaries of copyright eligibility for AI-generated works.

ip_top_stories.title: Delhi HC directs decision on copyright plea for AI-created artistic work
ip_top_stories.summary: The Delhi High Court has directed India's Copyright Office to decide within eight weeks whether AI-generated artwork can receive copyright protection, in a case brought by a US researcher. The ruling is seen as a significant moment for AI copyright jurisprudence in India, with potential global implications.

ip_top_stories.title: China Issues Draft Regulations on AI Copyright Infringement
ip_top_stories.summary: China has released draft regulations addressing copyright infringement by AI systems, marking a significant step in the country's efforts to regulate AI-generated content and the use of copyrighted material in AI training. The draft reflects growing global regulatory momentum on AI and intellectual property.

ip_top_stories.title: Anthropic's Legal Overhang: Piracy Trial Could Unravel Ethical AI Premium
ip_top_stories.summary: Analysis of the copyright litigation facing Anthropic examines how an upcoming piracy trial over training data could undermine the company's positioning as an ethical AI developer. The case has broad implications for how AI firms source and use copyrighted material in model training.

ip_top_stories.title: Cox v. Sony Music Comes to Hollywood
ip_top_stories.summary: The Cox v. Sony Music copyright case, involving internet service provider liability for user infringement, is drawing attention from Hollywood as its implications extend beyond the music industry to film and other content sectors. The case raises important questions about secondary liability for online platforms.

ip_further_links.title: Tech's AI Coding Boom On Collision Course With Copyright
ip_further_links.summary: The rapid growth of AI coding tools is raising unresolved copyright questions about the use of open-source and proprietary code in AI training datasets.

ip_further_links.title: AI And Human Authorship Requirement: Reflections From The US Position And Implications For Indian Copyright Law
ip_further_links.summary: Legal analysis comparing the US human-authorship requirement for copyright with its implications for how India may approach AI-generated works.

ip_further_links.title: Cox v Sony: Infringers gonna infringe – unless service providers encourage them
ip_further_links.summary: IPKat analysis of the Cox v Sony Music ruling examines the standard for ISP secondary liability for copyright infringement by users.

ip_further_links.title: Fordham 33 (Report 2): Top 5 Takeaways: Data Governance, Privacy, & Cybersecurity in an AI World
ip_further_links.summary: IPKat reports on key takeaways from the Fordham IP conference panel addressing data governance, privacy, and cybersecurity challenges raised by AI.

ip_further_links.title: Delhi HC Examines Copyright Eligibility of AI-Generated Art in Landmark DABUS Case
ip_further_links.summary: The Delhi High Court has issued notice in a case examining whether AI-generated art qualifies for copyright protection under Indian law, linked to the broader DABUS AI inventor controversy.

ip_further_links.title: India AI Copyright Case: Delhi Court Review Impacts Global IP Value
ip_further_links.summary: Analysis of how the Delhi High Court's review of AI copyright eligibility could have ripple effects on the global valuation of AI-related intellectual property.

ip_further_links.title: AI-Generated Animation: Implement Legal Regulations to Protect Copyright Holders
ip_further_links.summary: Commentary calling for clearer legal frameworks to protect copyright holders from the growing use of AI in animation and creative industries.

ip_further_links.title: Book Industry Unites to Back Authors
ip_further_links.summary: Publishers Weekly reports on a cross-industry initiative to support authors amid ongoing pressures including AI-related challenges to the publishing sector.

ip_further_links.title: Fordham 33 (Report 1): Government Leader's Perspective on IP
ip_further_links.summary: IPKat summarises government perspectives on intellectual property policy discussed at the Fordham IP Conference, including AI-related IP challenges.

ip_further_links.title: Fordham 33 (Report 3): Top 5 Takeaways: The Global Divide in Design Protection
ip_further_links.summary: IPKat reports on diverging international approaches to design protection discussed at the Fordham IP Conference.
